commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Oumar Diakite (Reims) inside the box.
90+2' What was Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+1' Amadou Kone (Reims) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amir Richardson.
90+1' A player from Reims commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
88' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Yehvann Diouf no chance!
87' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
86' Thibault De Smet (Reims) is awarded a yellow card.

86' Thibault De Smet (Reims) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Hakim Ben El Hadj with no other option than to blow for a foul. PENALTY to Strasbourg! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
85' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Junya Ito walks off the pitch to be replaced by Reda Khadra (Reims).
84' A pass by Angelo (Strasbourg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
83' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Joseph Okumu (Reims) but poses no threat.
81' Let's have a look at the offside statistics – 2:0.
81' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

75' Substitution. Dilane Bakwa walks off the pitch and Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
74' A quickly taken corner by Reims.

73' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

66' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Angelo (Strasbourg) for Junior Mwanga.

59' Strasbourg are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

47' Reims are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Hakim Ben El Hadj starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A pass into the penalty area from Junya Ito (Reims) is intercepted by the defence.

45+1' Junya Ito (Reims) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Matz Sels inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the right side of the target, but was denied by a great save.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

42' It's a goal! Mohamed Daramy (Reims) displays superb quick feet and dribbling as he jinks his way through multiple challenges and takes a shot from inside the box, which is deflected and goes past stranded Matz Sels. 2:0.
40' Golden chance! Amir Richardson (Reims) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
36' The corner by Teddy Teuma (Reims) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
35' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yehvann Diouf, who smothers the ball.
34' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg).

34' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Yehvann Diouf anticipates well and smothers the ball. Now Strasbourg have a corner.
34' Reims are ruled offside.
33' Gerzino Nyamsi (Strasbourg) and Emanuel Emegha try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
29' The Reims players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Thibault De Smet (Reims) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
25' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.

22' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
22' The linesman signals a throw-in for Reims.
18' The resulting corner, taken by Teddy Teuma (Reims), comes to nothing.
18' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Matz Sels thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
17' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
16' Reims are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' Thibault De Smet (Reims) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
13' Problems for Patrick Vieira as Gerzino Nyamsi (Strasbourg) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Abakar Sylla replaces him.
13' Gerzino Nyamsi (Strasbourg) picks up an injury.
10' 1 - 0 Amir Richardson (Reims) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
9' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
8' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
7' That's a well-taken pass by Amir Richardson (Reims). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
5' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
3' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) and Emanuel Emegha attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
